name: Early spring
text: in early spring, first green buds on bare branches, patches of melting snow, {crocuses|snowdrops} pushing through, cool fresh air

name: Spring
text: in spring, fresh green leaves, {cherry blossoms|wildflowers|apple blossoms}

name: Early summer
text: in early summer, lush bright green foliage, {fields of poppies|blooming roses|tall green grass}, long sunny days, mild warm air

name: High summer
text: in high summer, deep green trees, blazing sun, dry golden grass, buzzing insects, warm heavy air

name: Late summer
text: in late summer, ripe wheat fields, sunflowers, dusty golden light, first dry leaves, warm hazy evenings

name: Early autumn
text: in early autumn, first yellow leaves among the green, ripe apples, {misty mornings|clear crisp afternoons}, cooling air

name: Autumn
text: in autumn, golden and red leaves

name: Late autumn
text: in late autumn, nearly bare trees, brown fallen leaves on the ground, gray damp sky, cold wet air

name: Winter
text: in winter, bare trees, cold pale light

name: Deep winter
text: in deep winter, thick snow covering everything, icicles, frozen still landscape, {pale blue|steel gray} sky, breath freezing in the air
